question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
Here the correct answer is** Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The incorrectly spelled word is **"Abraod." **The correct spelling is** "Abroad."**
 
• **Adjust: **to change something slightly to make it fit, accommodate, or work better.
 
 
• Example: I had to **adjust **the settings on my phone to improve the sound quality.
 
 
 
• **Alive: **living or not dead; full of energy or vitality.
 
 
• Example: She was relieved to hear that her cat was still **alive **after being missing for several days.
 
 
 
• **Asleep:** in a state of sleep; not awake.
 
 
• Example: He was still **asleep **when his alarm clock went off in the morning.
 
 
 
• **Abroad:** in or to a foreign country or countries; away from one's own country.
 
 
• Example: She traveled **abroad **to learn more about different cultures and ways of life.
